events.name: ECB Interest Rate Decision
events.note: Expected quarter-point hike; press conference at 14:45 CET

deep_analysis.text: Gold's sharp drop alongside a firm VIX spike and a stronger DXY points to a classic risk-off tilt, with softer US yields the one inconsistent thread. Bitcoin's rally and equities' modest slip muddy the picture further, suggesting sentiment is jittery rather than uniformly defensive. Commodity currencies face crosscurrents as oil firms while copper slides, reflecting growth unease beneath the surface. Headlines center on rising Fed hike expectations alongside ECB tightening bets, keeping the dollar narrative live into today's US CPI print, which follows shortly and stands as the next major catalyst alongside back-to-back central bank decisions from the ECB, BoE, BoC, and RBNZ.
